# Vike Marketing

> Vike Marketing is a performance marketing agency run by Vladyslav from Lviv, Ukraine, working remotely with English-speaking small and growing businesses worldwide. Services: Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ads, Google Ads, SEO, creative production, social media management and marketing automation. Published pricing: Launch $200/month, Scale $400/month, Dominate $750/month; month-to-month, no contracts; ad spend paid directly to platforms and never marked up. Contact: sales@vikemarketing.com, +380 67 674 09 03.

## Services
- [Meta Ads Management for Small Businesses](https://vikemarketing.com/services/meta-ads-management/): Facebook and Instagram ad management focused on leads and sales: tracking, audience structure, creative testing and honest monthly reporting.
- [Google Ads Management for Small Businesses](https://vikemarketing.com/services/google-ads-management/): Google Ads management for small businesses: search intent research, conversion tracking, Performance Max and local campaigns, and clear monthly reporting.
- [SEO & AI Search Services for Small Businesses](https://vikemarketing.com/services/seo/): Practical SEO for small businesses: technical fixes, on-page optimization, local search and content that targets what your customers actually search.
- [Ad Creative Production for Meta & Google](https://vikemarketing.com/services/creative-production/): Ad creative produced for performance: concepts, hooks, static and short-form video ads for Meta, Google and TikTok, delivered in testable batches.

## Industries
- [Ecommerce Marketing: Meta & Google Ads](https://vikemarketing.com/industries/ecommerce/): Paid ads for online stores: catalog and Shopping campaigns, creative testing and retargeting built around contribution margin, not just ROAS.
- [Marketing for Dental Clinics, Salons & Gyms](https://vikemarketing.com/industries/local-services/): Ads and local SEO for dental clinics, beauty salons and gyms: booked appointments, Google Business Profile, reviews and fast lead follow-up.
- [Construction & Real Estate Marketing](https://vikemarketing.com/industries/construction-real-estate/): Lead generation for builders, renovators, developers and real estate agents: qualified project enquiries, long sales cycles and project-led creative.
- [Marketing for Schools & Education Businesses](https://vikemarketing.com/industries/education-schools/): Enrollment marketing for private schools, language schools, tutoring and course providers: parent-focused campaigns timed to the school calendar.

## Guides
- [We Reviewed 132 Marketing Agency Websites](https://vikemarketing.com/blog/marketing-agency-websites-research/): Original research: what 132 marketing agency homepages show and hide, from pricing and contracts to proof, headlines and forms, and what buyers should ask.
- [Why Creative Matters Most in Paid Social Ads](https://vikemarketing.com/blog/why-creative-matters-paid-social/): Why ad creative drives paid social performance: how platforms use creative to find buyers, what to test, spotting fatigue and building a creative pipeline.
- [Local SEO Basics: A Checklist for Small Businesses](https://vikemarketing.com/blog/local-seo-basics/): A practical local SEO checklist: optimize your Google Business Profile, earn genuine reviews, keep business details consistent and build useful location pages.
- [What a Realistic Ad Budget Looks Like for Small Business](https://vikemarketing.com/blog/realistic-ad-budget-small-business/): How to set a realistic advertising budget: work backwards from customer value and margin, fund a proper learning phase, and know when to scale.
- [Meta Ads vs Google Ads for Small Businesses](https://vikemarketing.com/blog/meta-ads-vs-google-ads-small-business/): Meta Ads vs Google Ads for small businesses: demand creation vs demand capture, how to compare costs fairly, and a simple framework for choosing where to start.
- [How to Choose a Marketing Agency for a Small Business](https://vikemarketing.com/blog/how-to-choose-a-marketing-agency/): A practical guide for small business owners: what to ask a marketing agency, red flags to avoid, how pricing models compare and what month one should look like.
